name: folklore
llm_description: folklore is Taylor Swift's eighth studio album, a surprise quarantine release that abandoned pop for stripped-back indie folk and alternative sounds, spinning fictional narratives and third-person storytelling with collaborators like Aaron Dessner and Bon Iver.
llm_emotion_analysis: Melancholy and introspective; wistful, escapist storytelling with bittersweet nostalgia, loss, and quiet longing.
llm_overall_public_reception: Universally acclaimed; won Album of the Year at the Grammys, and was widely hailed as a bold artistic reinvention and one of the best albums of 2020.
